key.name: equalizer-enabled
key.description: Whether the real-time PipeWire filter-chain equalizer backend is active.

key.name: active-preset
key.description: Identifier of the currently selected equalizer preset.

key.name: band-gains
key.description: Gain values in dB (-12.0 to +12.0) for 32Hz, 64Hz, 125Hz, 250Hz, 500Hz, 1kHz, 2kHz, 4kHz, 8kHz, and 16kHz.

key.name: bass-gain
key.description: Low-shelf biquad filter gain at 100Hz in dB (-12.0 to +12.0).

key.name: treble-gain
key.description: High-shelf biquad filter gain at 10kHz in dB (-12.0 to +12.0).

key.name: custom-presets
key.description: JSON object mapping custom preset IDs to their name, 10 band gains, bass gain, and treble gain.

key.name: preferred-player
key.description: The D-Bus name of the user's last selected MPRIS media player.

key.name: show-remaining-time
key.description: If true, displays remaining track time (-MM:SS); otherwise displays total track duration (MM:SS).

key.name: show-track-in-panel
key.summary: Show current track title in Top Bar
key.description: Whether to display the currently playing track title next to the Top Bar icon.

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Where to place the indicator on the GNOME Top Bar: left, center, or right.

key.name: layout-mode
key.description: Layout mode for the popup interface: dual-panel, vertical, compact, music-only, or eq-only.

key.name: popup-scale
key.description: Scale factor for popup dimensions: small, medium, or large.

key.name: left-panel-width
key.summary: Music & Media panel width in pixels
key.description: Width of the left Music & Media panel in Dual Panel layout (or total width in Vertical/Music-Only layouts).

key.name: right-panel-width
key.description: Width of the right Equalizer panel in Dual Panel layout (or total width in Equalizer-Only layout).

key.name: show-album-art
key.description: Whether to display the album cover artwork in the Music & Media panel.

key.name: show-media-source
key.description: Whether to display the Media Source & Video/Audio stream information card at the bottom of the Music panel.

key.name: show-bass-treble
key.description: Whether to display the Bass and Treble shelf sliders below the 10-band Equalizer.

key.name: show-time-info
key.summary: Show track elapsed and remaining time
key.description: Whether to display the current time and remaining/total time labels under the progress bar.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Primary accent color for sliders, active buttons, and badges (e.g. #257ef9, #00c4cc, #8b5cf6, #10b981, #f59e0b, #ec4899).

key.name: popup-opacity
key.description: Background opacity of the dark glassmorphic popup container (25% to 100%).
